articles.title: Biofuels will prove to be a highly suitable alternative in the energy transition
articles.description: Biofuels offer the most immediate opportunity, as they can be blended into existing fuel systems with limited infrastructure changes.

articles.title: Eni Reactivates 'Supergiant' Venezuelan Oilfield
articles.description: Junin-5 restarted operations following the execution of the new license between Eni and Venezuela, under which the heavy oil field is planned to increase production to 200,000 barrels per day by 2028.

articles.title: bp posts 304% jump in third-quarter net income to $4.7bn
articles.description: bp has reported a 304% year-on-year increase in the Q3 2026 net profit to $4.7bn, driven by stronger refining margins and higher trading performance.

articles.title: Ineos Responds to UK Budget
articles.description: The UK's Autumn Budget was described by global chemical company Ineos as 'a major missed opportunity to save British manufacturing'.

articles.title: Equinor Doubles Estimate for Afrodite Gas Discovery
articles.description: An appraisal well showed that the Afrodite discovery near the Kvitebjorn field on Norway's side of the North Sea potentially holds 77-180 million barrels of oil equivalent recoverable natural gas and condensate.

articles.title: European Gas Tops 101 Euros for First Time Since 2022
articles.description: Europe’s benchmark natural gas prices have topped 101 euros per megawatt-hour (MWh) for the first time since the 2022 crisis as winter looms amid historically low European gas storage levels. The front-month price at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF), the benchmark for Europe’s gas trading, surged by 4% as of 9 a.m. in Amsterdam on Friday. articles.title: TotalEnergies posts $8.3bn Q3 net income on refining gains
articles.description: TotalEnergies more than doubled its net income in the third quarter of 2026 (Q3 2026), posting $8.3bn compared with $3.7bn a year earlier.

articles.title: Trump Considers Lifting Sanctions on Putin’s ‘Slush Fund’
articles.description: Four days after Russia launched its all-out effort to subjugate Ukraine, the US government and other Western allies fired a broadside of financial sanctions aimed at punishing the Kremlin’s wallet for the assault. The Russian Central Bank was prominent. So was a multibillion-dollar sovereign wealth fund that the Kremlin calls the Russian Direct Investment Fund, or RDIF. articles.title: BP Posts Highest Quarterly Profit in 18 Years
articles.description: BP said profit surged to the highest in 18 years as soaring refining margins boosted earnings, while a sharp drop in net debt moved the British energy major closer to a position where it could restart buybacks.

articles.title: Japan to Tap $7 Billion from Government Fund to Subsidize Gasoline Prices
articles.description: Japan’s government on Friday decided to tap $7 billion from its contingency reserves to keep subsidies for gasoline and other fuels, even as it plans to gradually scale back the support from December. The Japanese government decided today to allocate about $7 billion (1.1 trillion Japanese yen) from the reserve funds to continue capping retail gasoline prices amid soaring oil and fuel import costs, Japanese media reported. articles.title: Shell net income surges 128% to $12.1bn in Q3 2026
articles.description: Shell posted Q3 2026 net income attributable to shareholders of $12.1bn, more than double the $5.3bn recorded in Q3 2025..

articles.title: Brent Hits $117 as Tanker Catches Fire in Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: Tensions in the Middle East are escalating again as a tanker was reported on fire after explosive devices were attached to its hull while the vessel was attempting to transit outbound in the Strait of Hormuz. The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), which is affiliated with the Royal Navy, said in a warning notice that it had received a third report on Thursday that a tanker transiting outbound was on fire 25 nautical miles northeast of Khasab, Oman, in the Strait of Hormuz. articles.title: Mazarine Energy agrees to buy Romania’s BSOG from Carlyle and EBRD
articles.description: Mazarine Energy to acquire Black Sea Oil & Gas (BSOG) from Carlyle and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).

articles.title: Oil Markets Caught Between Iran War Risks and Emergency SPR Releases
articles.description: Crude oil gave back ground on Thursday as traders weighed emergency supply against tentative efforts to reopen talks with Iran. Neither side has taken control. The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is delivering barrels, but the reserve is near its lowest level since 1982. Peace efforts have resurfaced, but no agreement has been reached, and the threat to regional shipping and Saudi energy infrastructure remains. articles.description: Politics, Geopolitics & Conflict Bolsonaro has been secretly flown to Miami on a private jet, three days after losing Brazil’s presidential runoff to Lula and a day after defying a Supreme Court order to surrender his passports in a money-laundering case. articles.title: Israel’s Election Deadlock Opens the Door to Another Iran Offensive
articles.description: Netanyahu’s bloc fell eight seats short of a Knesset majority on October 27, winning 53 of 120 seats to 48 for Gadi Eisenkot’s camp. The Arab parties took a record 19 on turnout of about 80% in Arab communities, up from 54% in 2022. Netanyahu will stay on as caretaker PM until a new government is sworn in. articles.title: BP Quadruples Profit to Record as War Boosts Refining and Trading
articles.description: BP easily beat analyst expectations of third-quarter earnings, posting its highest quarterly profit, which nearly quadrupled from a year earlier amid strong refining margins and oil and gas trading. BP’s underlying replacement cost profit, the metric is uses for net profit, soared to $8.6 billion for the third quarter, nearly quadrupling from the same period of 2025, the supermajor said on Friday. articles.description: Brent Crude oil prices are set to end the year at about $105 per barrel, bank ANZ said on Friday as it hiked its projection by $10 a barrel on the assumption that Middle East oil exports, shipping availability, and fuel supplies will remain constrained through December. “The forecast does not require another geopolitical shock,” ANZ’s strategists wrote in a note carried by Bloomberg. “Rather, it assumes that the constraints already confronting Middle Eastern exports, shipping and refined-product markets persist through…

articles.title: High Oil Prices Set to Trigger New Wave of North Sea Mergers
articles.description: High oil and gas prices are going to drive further consolidation in the UK sector of the North, according to analysts, who also said tax considerations would play a role in stimulating M&A appetite in the region. The expectations come from a Reuters poll among analysts and bankers, who said the oil and gas price inflation driven by the war in the Middle East has made mergers and acquisitions in the space more tempting—even in the UK’s North Sea, where the energy industry has been targeted by half a dozen successive UK governments…

articles.title: Houthis Claim Fresh Strikes on Saudi Oil Refineries and Aramco Facilities
articles.description: The Yemeni Houthis claimed a fresh series of attacks on Saudi targets, including oil infrastructure: two refineries and a facility at the Abqaiq oil field. The Houthis struck the Ras Tanura refinery and the Rabigh refinery, the Houthis’ spokesperson Yahya Saree said in a post on X, plus “the Aramco facility in Buqayq”. Saree claimed success in all the latest attacks, which also included the King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and the King Khalid Airport in Riyadh. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed the attacks or their impact…

articles.title: Oil Prices Head for Fourth Monthly Gain as Middle East Tensions Escalate
articles.description: Crude oil prices were set for another weekly gain today, also extending their monthly rise to four months in a row amid continued fears of escalation in the Middle East and Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $116.56 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $103.35 per barrel ahead of the November 3rd U.S. midterm elections. articles.title: Oil Wavers on Conflicting Reports of USA Military Moves
articles.description: Oil fluctuated in a choppy session as traders weighed conflicting signals on the direction of U.S. military strategy in Iran.

articles.title: Off-Grid Solar Is Now the Cheapest Power for Nearly 400 Million People
articles.description: The World Bank now ranks off-grid solar as the cheapest way to bring electricity to at least 398 million people who still live without it. A joint report released this week by the World Bank’s Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP) and the off-grid solar industry association GOGLA treats the technology as permanent infrastructure.
